files.scope: Add FailureRoute enum, FailureOrigin enum, FailureStatus enum, FailureDiagnosticType enum, RepairContextStatus enum. Add WorkflowEventType entries: FAILURE_CAPTURED, FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS_PARSED, FAILURE_CLASSIFIED, ENVIRONMENT_ACTION_REQUIRED, EXTERNAL_RETRY_SCHEDULED, DIAGNOSTIC_HOLD_ENTERED, REPAIR_CONTEXT_CREATED, REPAIR_CONTEXT_BLOCKED.
Register new failure and repair-context route modules.
Register new services/repositories for failure evidence, C-Lite routing, and repair context.
Add DIAGNOSTIC_HOLD state handling and failure-context state projections.
Add FailureModel, FailureDiagnosticModel, FailureRouteModel, FailureAttemptModel, RepairContextPackModel tables.
Add transition validation for failure evidence capture, C-Lite classification, diagnostic hold, and repair context creation.
New Alembic migration for G05 tables (failures, failure_diagnostics, failure_routes, failure_attempts, repair_context_packs).
Integrate FailureEvidenceViewer, FailureRouteCard, ContextInspector components into the run dashboard.
Add SSE handlers for new failure/routing/repair-context event types.
Add event-to-state projection for failure/routing/repair-context events.
Add TypeScript types for failure evidence, C-Lite routing, and repair context API contracts.
Update with new failure-evidence, classify, route, retry, and repair-context endpoints.

integration_notes: Shared file edits are declared before production edits. Aggregate generated contracts (OpenAPI, generated TypeScript) are integration-coordinator owned per OWNERSHIP.yaml but documented here for shared awareness.
Alembic migration must be a new head, not a modification of prior migration chain heads.
